language_common.label: Common
language_common.signature: Keep the varied human core, with measured dental voicing and small vowel turns. No theatrical accent or dialect biography.

language_low_common.label: Low Common
language_low_common.signature: Related human contours contract: reduced inner vowels and short, firm endings, without implying simple thought. Preserve the ea unit rather than collapsing ears/pears into eir/peer shapes.

language_gutterspeak.label: Gutterspeak
language_gutterspeak.signature: Cant-like st/sk and tr/vr turns, slanted vowels and voiced hisses retain Common roots. A language, not a universal damaged-lung effect. Preserve the ea unit rather than collapsing ears/pears into eir/peer shapes.

language_dwarven.label: Dwarven
language_dwarven.signature: Firm interlocking contacts and au/u depth suggest the ordered FAR cells; retain root consonants and allow substantial endings. Substantial fitted endings add an interlocking final beat while retaining the original lexical root. A substantial num return preserves n and avoids the witnessed wooden-end reading of woodendun.

language_gnomish.label: Gnomish
language_gnomish.signature: Bright, precise ei/e vowels and tiny stop linkages separate neat Gnomish articulation from Goblin compression.  Retain the th spine under a tiny doubled dental stop, separating three from tree. Goblin oo compresses to u so wooden retains its rounded core instead of becoming widen.

language_darnassian.label: Darnassian
language_darnassian.signature: Liquid elven interiors resolve toward open ae/ta/na endings. Keep recognizable roots rather than substituting ornate new words. Open releases carry the flowing elven silhouette while preserving the readable lexical spine.

language_high_darnassian.label: High Darnassian
language_high_darnassian.signature: Extend the shared elven endings into balanced aela/nela/tala returns. Literal bounded endings suggest the FAR closing arch without new grammar. Related open stems grow a balanced closing arch; long endings stay off the shortest words.

language_elunic.label: Elunic
language_elunic.signature: Measured ea/eia/nia vowel returns and soft contact convey a quieter elven cadence; no compulsory piety or ritual timing. Soft measured vowel returns resolve ordinary roots into a quiet sustained cadence.

language_thalassian.label: Thalassian
language_thalassian.signature: Retain liquid ae interiors, but finish with crisp s/ns contacts rather than the open Darnassian release.

language_shalassian.label: Shalassian
language_shalassian.signature: Compressed e/i interiors, a narrow medial contraction and lingering aai/tai/nai release suggest compressed centers and extended endings. Contraction never removes a whole word. Compressed inner correspondence and a lingering final turn remain audible rather than losing the finish to an earlier vowel change.

language_nazja.label: Nazja
language_nazja.signature: Hold ss/sh around an inherited ae/ia elven core. This coiling voice stays distinct from the dry narrow Sethrak bank. An elven-shaped vowel return is enclosed in sustained sibilants, preserving original stop contacts.

language_qiraji.label: Qiraji
language_qiraji.signature: Weighty q/kh and kt/nk contacts bound broad aa chambers; readable fragments stand in for FAR articulated compounds. Substantial articulated catches distinguish the weightier insect voice without hiding the stem.

language_nerubian.label: Nerubian
language_nerubian.signature: Organized tk/tch/ksh clicks and dry sk/nk catches remain jointed and precise. No apostrophe spray or new sign-language narration. Ordered hard clicks and dry catches sit at clear word boundaries, including ordinary nouns previously unchanged.

language_mantid.label: Mantid
language_mantid.signature: Slender i/ii nuclei and ts/zh/z buzzing edges keep these small units lighter than Qiraji and less rasped than Nerubian. Thin i-bearing buzz edges keep packets light and exact, distinct from the larger insect catches. Thinner nz/gz buzz catches keep the packets compact and reduce newly noun-like iz endings.

language_vrykul.label: Vrykul
language_vrykul.signature: Broad northern vowels, sk attacks and firm voiced endings; do not turn the language into a real-world accent imitation.

language_drust.label: Drust
language_drust.signature: Keep the northern shape with hr/vr breath, reduced centers and rough lingering th. No assertion of death or corruption.

language_apexis.label: Apexis
language_apexis.signature: Bright avian ii/ei/ai and repeated rhotics end in a clean ringing release. Ordered articulation survives the beak-inspired surface. Bright ringing releases make the avian cadence audible after its crisp internal contacts.

language_ravenspeech.label: Ravenspeech
language_ravenspeech.signature: The same avian range contracts into kr/sk/kh croaks, dark vowels and a final catch; never replace a sentence with caws. Related avian forms lower into clipped croaks and a rough final catch.

language_orcish.label: Orcish
language_orcish.signature: Guttural gh/kh contacts, dark inner vowels and hard closure retain the lexical spine. Replace starter gater/grefore distortions with vater/brefore.

language_ogre.label: Ogre
language_ogre.signature: Round o/oo/ou mouthfuls, heavy voiced attacks and rolled returns; full syntax and the original intelligence remain. Retain the original p under a doubled stop; prevent pears/prisoner/pay turning into bears/brisoner/bay. Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts. Rounded substantial rro/num/lor returns preserve original stems and resolve large mouthfuls into voiced closures.

language_draconic.label: Draconic
language_draconic.signature: Deep aa/au chambers and vr/zh/kh friction suggest layered dragon resonance while preserving root attacks.

language_furbolg.label: Furbolg / Ursine
language_furbolg.signature: Warm low aa/uu, breath-heavy wh/hr and hummed closures keep ursine resonance without making water into mater.

language_gnoll.label: Gnoll
language_gnoll.signature: Bright ay yelp turns collide with gr/kr/gh and ragged breath catches. Root s is retained instead of replaced by y.

language_wolvar.label: Wolvar
language_wolvar.signature: Compact wr/gn onsets and nk/rr closures carry a tight snarl, distinct from Gnoll bright yelps.

language_pygmy.label: Pygmy
language_pygmy.signature: Quick ei/i turns and small clean nasal releases; stature changes the sound conception, never the meaning or sophistication.

language_hozen.label: Hozen
language_hozen.signature: Bouncing ou pockets and rolled contacts with small lip-pop closures; keep the source proposition rather than add comic filler.

language_nerglish.label: Nerglish
language_nerglish.signature: Liquid brl/bl/gl chains and oo pockets suggest bubbling inner continuity. Retain b/t/ch roots so words stay decipherable. Liquid chains and rolling vowel pockets continue through the ending, preserving the aquatic lexical stem.  Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts. Alternate light i, rounded u/uu and broad a pockets instead of giving every returning liquid chain the same lu ending.

language_quilboar.label: Quilboar
language_quilboar.signature: Nasal sn/ng pressure and gr/kh catches echo thorny snorting FAR compounds. Firm endings keep source consonants.  Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts.

language_tolvir.label: Tol'vir
language_tolvir.signature: Processional aa/ae chambers and exact inscription-like t/dt edges; source articulation remains audible within an old ordered shape.

language_titanic.label: Titanic
language_titanic.signature: Discrete repeatable vowel cells and restrained returning endings suggest ordered architecture without borrowing FAR cells verbatim. Repeatable bounded cells provide an ordered second chamber rather than generic vowel distortion.

language_giant.label: Giant
language_giant.signature: Enlarge ordered vowel chambers into aa/oa/uu with substantial voiced afterweight. Preserve complex thought and normal sentence length.  Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts.

language_tortollan.label: Tortollan
language_tortollan.signature: Rounded oi/ou cells return through ora/on. Preserve word attacks that the starter replaced, letting endings carry the unhurried cadence. Rounded cells unfold into a recurring deliberate ending without sacrificing the original word attack.

language_drogbar.label: Drogbar
language_drogbar.signature: Grinding dr/gr/kh centers deliberately release into oa/ta/na endings, matching FAR open finals rather than generic hard cavern speech. A grinding center releases into a final vowel; both parts are now present in the same short readable word. Retain g with rough aspiration instead of converting gate into the distinct English object grate; the grinding open cadence supplies the remaining texture.

language_tuskarr.label: Tuskarr
language_tuskarr.signature: Compact rounded u/uu with fr/rl attacks and stout nasal holds; keep colder compactness separate from broad Taur-ahe and rolling Tortollan.  Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts.

language_maraudic.label: Maraudic
language_maraudic.signature: A muscular tr/z pulse and rolling ay with blunt dt/rn returns imply a galloping cadence through sound, without changing rhythm or syntax.

language_shathyar.label: Shath'yar
language_shathyar.signature: Asymmetric lth/vr/nh contacts and returning aa/yi pockets suggest alien friction; reduce starter nzhot tangles to readable nhot. Returning fragments meet uneven alien joins; the familiar stem still carries meaning.

language_kalimag.label: Kalimag
language_kalimag.signature: Firm gr/t roots resolve into sonorant ta/un/ara returns, a coherent elemental mixture rather than the heaviest elemental voice. Firm original roots resolve through resonant returns, balancing the elemental constructions. Preserve long i before a final consonant-plus-silent-e sequence; retain other short inner-vowel shifts. This avoids the witnessed nine/one ambiguity without a number-word exception.

language_ignan.label: Ignan
language_ignan.signature: Crisp kr/sk and k catches punctuated by eh/nh/sh breath releases. Preserve main roots while suggesting fractured ignition without new hyphens. Fractured hard stops alternate with small sustained releases. Preserve long i before a final consonant-plus-silent-e sequence; retain other short inner-vowel shifts. This avoids the witnessed nine/one ambiguity without a number-word exception.

language_terran.label: Terran
language_terran.signature: Packed gr/kk/dt/nd/dg closures surround rounded low cores, remaining denser and more closed than Kalimag. Packed closed contacts put weight at the word edge and retain the enclosed earthy construction. Retain the original p under a doubled stop; prevent pears/prisoner/pay turning into bears/brisoner/bay.

language_aquan.label: Aquan
language_aquan.signature: Connected ua/ou bridges and soft sl/vr links flow to open releases. Keep consonant identities that starter gl/ve obscured. Connected vowel bridges open the finish as well as the interior.

language_auran.label: Auran
language_auran.signature: wh/rh/bh breath groups and airy ae/ai, with softened dh/kh edges. Retain onset b rather than turn before into fefore. Light breath catches disperse the ending without swallowing its original consonant.

language_sethrak.label: Sethrak
language_sethrak.signature: Dry ss/sz friction and narrow i/ii distinguish a desert serpent voice from Nazja inherited elven ae/ia.

language_vulpera.label: Vulpera
language_vulpera.signature: Nimble ei/oi and soft v/f contacts with little light releases. Keep word roots rather than turn every b/s into another consonant.

language_mogu.label: Mogu
language_mogu.signature: Stamped gr/dt/dg units and broad u/uu build a heavy imperial sound distinct from warm Pandaren and connected Jinyu. Retain the original p under a doubled stop; prevent pears/prisoner/pay turning into bears/brisoner/bay. Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts.

language_jinyu.label: Jinyu
language_jinyu.signature: ua/eo eddies, ry/ny liquid-nasal links and soft open releases; retaining root stops improves readability of the flowing bank.

language_pandaren.label: Pandaren
language_pandaren.signature: Warm balanced ao/u and soft voiced contacts resolve into a restrained crisp dt beat, rather than universally nasalized ends.

language_eredun.label: Eredun
language_eredun.signature: Harsh kr/zh roots, weighty aa/uu and rough ng/th release remain kin to Draenei resonance while making no moral claim about the speaker. Weighty roots finish in rough forceful contact, retaining the Argussian connection with a harder outer edge.

language_nathrezim.label: Nathrezim
language_nathrezim.signature: Silken ae/ael interiors and controlled vr/zh/th/nr edges feel poised and unsettling. Voice alone reveals no scheme or private intent. Smooth vowels narrow into poised precise closures; no intent or personality is added.

language_cursed.label: Cursed
language_cursed.signature: Hollow aa/oa returns with kh/wh breath and nh/eth catches. Preserve the starter lost w, so water remains whater rather than hater.

language_draenei.label: Draenei
language_draenei.signature: Patient low aa/ua/ei resonance returns through eia/na/ta, gentler and more connected than Eredun command edges. Connected low resonance and patient vowel returns preserve the gentler Argussian contour.

language_zandali.label: Zandali
language_zandali.signature: Rolling zr/rr, voiced z and open ay/ta/na maintain a strong syllabic pulse. No real-world English accent or added status suffixes.

language_taurahe.label: Taur-ahe
language_taurahe.signature: Broad low aa/au/uu with hr breath and nasal/liquid returns, more spacious than Tuskarr compact rounded roots. Broad nasal/liquid returns add room at the finish while retaining the low rounded interiors.

language_goblin.label: Goblin
language_goblin.signature: Pinched e/i, compressed inner vowels and sharp kr/z/bz/k edges distinguish market-speed Goblin from precise bright Gnomish. No forced comedy or greed. Retain the original p under a doubled stop; prevent pears/prisoner/pay turning into bears/brisoner/bay. Hold e before doubled l, avoiding well/wall/will collisions while retaining other inner-vowel shifts. Retain the th spine under a tiny doubled dental stop, separating three from tree. Goblin oo compresses to u so wooden retains its rounded core instead of becoming widen.
